تصطفوا (form VIII)
# تَصْطَفُوا (taṣṭafū) /tasˤ.tˤa.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
# تُصْطَفَوْا (tuṣṭafaw) /tusˤ.tˤa.faw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَفَى (iṣṭafā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
